positions.name: LegacyRecordArchivalStrategy
positions.frame: how should closed legacy platform records and their operational meaning be preserved when migrating off a vendor system?
positions.why: The group weighs the long-term decay and dual-system behavioral risks of leaving a legacy platform running read-only against extracting closed history into flat, self-describing, open-format archives with explicit semantic documentation.

positions.name: DecommissioningRetentionSequencing
positions.frame: at what point in vendor exit negotiations must legal retention mandates and data extraction scoping be established?
positions.why: The team deliberates on the sequencing of decommissioning terms, establishing that formal legal retention periods and technical extraction scoping must precede signing exit agreements with the vendor.
